BBC Micro core vendored from Tom Harte's CLK (MIT licensed):
https://github.com/TomHarte/CLK

Upstream commit: 5e4ff31 (master, Oct 2026) -- shallow clone at
~/code/CLK. Only the BBC Micro (Model B, 1770 DFS) subset is vendored;
all other machines, tape/analyser parsers and OS bindings are excluded.

Vendored directories (complete):
  Processors/6502Mk2        6502 CPU (header-only, self-contained decoder)
  Components/6845           Motorola CRTC
  Components/6522           2x MOS VIA (system + user)
  Components/6850           Motorola ACIA (serial line unconnected)
  Components/SN76489        TI sound chip
  Components/SAA5050        Mullard teletext serialiser (MODE 7)
  Components/uPD7002        NEC ADC (analogue joysticks)
  Components/1770           WD1770 FDC logic
  Outputs/CRT               analogue CRT model (Flywheel/RectAccumulator)
  Outputs/Speaker           speaker resampling chain
  Outputs/ScanTarget.hpp    host video interface (implemented in src/bbc)
  Outputs/Log.hpp           compile-time gated logging (no-op under NDEBUG)
  ClockReceiver/            cycle/time types
  Numeric/                  fixed-size int helpers, curves
  Concurrency/SpinLock.hpp  atomics-only spin lock (bare-metal safe)
  Inputs/                   keyboard/joystick abstractions
  Activity/                 drive-lamp/activity observers
  Configurable/             user-friendly options (dynamic crop)
  Reflection/               options reflection
  SignalProcessing/         FIR filter (speaker low-pass)

Vendored files (selected):
  Machines/Acorn/BBCMicro/{BBCMicro.hpp,BBCMicro.cpp,Keyboard.hpp}
  Machines/Acorn/Floppy/{1770.hpp,1770.cpp}

  Machines/Utility/{ROMCatalogue,MemoryFuzzer,Typer}.hpp+cpp
  Analyser/Static/StaticAnalyser.hpp, Analyser/Machines.hpp,
    Analyser/Static/Acorn/Target.hpp (target struct only; no parsers)
  Storage/{Storage.hpp,FileHolder.hpp,FileHolder.cpp}
  Storage/Disk/{Disk.hpp,Drive.hpp,Drive.cpp}
  Storage/Disk/Controller/{DiskController,MFMDiskController}.hpp+cpp
  Storage/Disk/Track/*, Storage/Disk/Encodings/MFM/*, Storage/Disk/DPLL/*
  Storage/Disk/DiskImage/{DiskImage.hpp,DiskImageImplementation.hpp}
  Storage/Disk/DiskImage/Formats/{SSD,AcornADF,MFMSectorDump}.hpp+cpp

  Storage/Disk/Parsers/*.hpp (headers only, for MFMSectorDump)
  Machines/MachineTypes.hpp, Machines/MouseMachine.hpp,
    Machines/StateProducer.hpp (interface headers)
  Machines/Acorn/Tube/*.hpp (headers only; WDC65C02/Z80 tube variants
    instantiate at compile time via create()'s switch but never run)
  Processors/Z80/{Z80.hpp,Implementation/Z80Storage.cpp,
    Implementation/PartialMachineCycle.cpp} (+ parse-only headers
    Z80/Implementation/*, Inputs/Mouse.hpp, Numeric/RegisterSizes.hpp)
    -- Z80 tube member linkage only
  Processors/Bus/{Data,PartialAddresses}.hpp
  Components/{Serial/Line.hpp+cpp,SID/SID.hpp+cpp} (ACIA line; BeebSID
    member instantiated even when disabled)
  Outputs/ScanTarget.cpp (NullScanTarget singleton)
  Storage/{TimedEventLoop.hpp+cpp,Cartridge/Cartridge.hpp,
    FileBundle/FileBundle.hpp,MassStorage/MassStorageDevice.hpp,
    Tape/Tape.hpp,TargetPlatforms.hpp}
  ClockReceiver/{ClockReceiver,ClockingHintSource}.hpp,
    SignalProcessing/{Stepper,BiquadFilter}.hpp

Excluded: all other Machines/*, all other Storage/Disk/DiskImage/Formats/*,
Storage/Tape/*, Analyser/Static/Acorn/StaticAnalyser.cpp+Disk.cpp+Tape.cpp,
OSBindings/*, Tube second processors, BeebSID, Master 128 (CLK's BBCMicro
core covers Model B/B+ only).

BMX adaptations (no vendored file is modified):
  bmx-shim/bbc_prefix.h  force-included (-include): no-op std::mutex and
    std::condition_variable (bare-metal newlib has no threads). Mirrors
    third_party/stella/bmx-shim/stella_prefix.h. All core objects live on
    the single emulator thread, so this is correct.
  bmx-shim/Concurrency/AsyncTaskQueue.hpp  shadows upstream via -I order:
    synchronous inline queue with identical template/member API. Upstream
    spawns a std::thread per queue (audio queue); here actions run inline
    at enqueue time, preserving serial order.
  Compiler: -std=c++20 (concepts, <=>, span), RTTI kept (CLK uses
    dynamic_cast in ScanProducer/TimedMachine/Configurable paths; vAmiga
    precedent allows RTTI), exceptions kept (a2600 precedent).

BMX PATCH P1 (Machines/Acorn/BBCMicro/BBCMicro.cpp, insert_media): map
  Media.disks[0..1] onto 1770 drives 0/1 (upstream: front -> drive 0
  only). Needed for the two DFS drives in the menu. Re-setting an
  unchanged drive only flushes write-back tracks and re-seeks.
  ROMs (16 KiB each, sideways slots): OS MOS 1.20 (paged C000-FFFF),
    Acorn BASIC II (slot 15), Acorn 1770 DFS 2.26 (slot 14), optional
    ADFS 1.30. Fetched by tools/download_roms.py into /roms/BBC.
